name: Feature List
description: Plain checklist of capabilities with a mark. Reads faster than a grid when there are more than six items.
html:
• Unlimited environments per project
  • Preview URL for every pull request
  • Audit log with 90 day retention
  • SSO on Team and above
  • Dedicated IP addresses

variants.name: Two column
variants.description: The single checklist splits into two text columns from md, each item kept whole so no row breaks across the gutter.
variants.guidance: Sits inside a plan card or beneath a pricing table where a tall single column would push the action off the fold. Best for eight to fourteen short items that read as a set. Avoid it for fewer than six items, because two columns of three look like a mistake. Pairs with pricing-tier-cards:single-plan, whose one card has the width two columns need.
variants.html:
• Unlimited environments per project
  • Preview URL for every pull request
  • Audit log with 90 day retention
  • Instant rollback to any previous build
  • Custom domains with automatic certificates
  • SSO on Team and above
  • Log export on Team and above
  • Dedicated IP addresses

variants.name: Checklist inline
variants.description: Items wrap along the line as a static rail instead of stacking, so the whole list occupies two or three lines rather than a column.
variants.guidance: Sits directly under a hero or a price as a one glance summary. Best for short items of three or four words each, where the point is coverage rather than detail. Avoid it for anything longer than about five words per item, because a wrapping rail of sentences loses its rhythm. Pairs with hero-split:centered above it, and it stays a static rail rather than a scrolling ticker, which is law 9.
variants.html:
• Unlimited environments
  • Preview URLs
  • 90 day audit log
  • Instant rollback
  • SSO on Team
  • Dedicated IPs
